title: Places your way, a better media gallery, easier searching
notes: Places: a coop, box, shelf, hutch or any kind of place you invent — and anything can go inside anything. Pick your kinds in the Add place form.
“What I keep” is now tick boxes (parrots, chickens, both…) and decides which kinds of place the menus offer first.
Media: switch between list and grid, tap a title to rename it, open photos full screen and swipe through them.
Contacts show their photo — or their initials, or a business icon.
Every list now has search and the add button together at the top; tap the search box and it opens wide.
The year on Accounting is now the menu itself, between the arrows.
A new Media icon, and a sign-out button right on your profile.
My Birds now wears the bird you keep — a chicken for chicken keepers, a parrot for parrot keepers.

title: Sign-in and sample data
notes: Sign in with your email — each aviary has its own private account.
Try everything with a made-up sample aviary, and remove it whenever you’re ready to start with your own.
Awards and show results with photos, and your health tests with retest reminders.
